name: sprintf
expr: r1 = double(strlength(sprintf('%d', 42))); r2 = double(strcmp(sprintf('%d', 42), '42')); r3 = double(strcmp(sprintf('%.2f', 3.14159), '3.14'));
comment: Sig: r = sprintf(fmt, ...). Spec-extension batch 2026-05-09. Note: numkit sprintf("...") with double-quoted format returns empty — only single-quoted char format works. Documented as separate gap (string vs char distinction in format arg).
